experiment: M7R-2: a new prospective experiment that reruns the M7R contract at a pre-registered pair count. M7R round 3 remains FAIL.
mechanism: reusable context-owned FREE_DESCRIPTOR_SET pool blocks (see round3)
teardownAttribution: A bracketed locked diagnostic (c5/td2) found the M7R teardown excess moves entirely onto whichever object is released first: a never-used 256-byte buffer release took 22 us on main and 54 us on m7r. An explicit settle first cost 1-2 us in both, and the params release that follows was unchanged (15-16 us). The excess is deferred cleanup that main pays inside each iteration through its per-submit pool destroys; m7r pays it once at teardown. It is counted in complete.

sampling.inputs: c1 frozen inputs and independent oracles
sampling.powerBasis: Pair count chosen by empirical bootstrap power simulation from the round-3 per-pair complete ratios (doe-work/c4/power2.py, retained): resample n pairs from the observed distribution, compute the same 95% bootstrap CI of the median, and target at least 80% power per gate. Round-3 estimates: upload/readback bound 1.02 at an assumed true ratio of 1.00 reaches 0.865 power at 72 pairs; image 0.98 at 48; vector 0.86 at 24. 96 adds margin for joint power.

metric: complete = compileNs + pipelineNs + resourcesNs + sum of every iteration's operation interval + teardownNs (CPU oracle excluded). Ratios are candidate/main per balanced pair; bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 20261029.

acceptance.dispatchWorkloads: vector and image: complete CI95 upper < 1.0 AND warm.submit CI95 upper < 1.0
acceptance.uploadReadbackBound: buffer_upload_readback_exact_1mb: complete CI95 upper <= 1.02 (unchanged from M7R)
acceptance.phaseGuard: no warm phase on any workload with ratio CI95 lower > 1.05
acceptance.verdict: pass only if every workload window is valid and dispatchWorkloads, uploadReadbackBound and phaseGuard all hold

validity.perWindowGate: Each workload runs in its own timed window under the GPU lock, with the four participant units stopped. A window is INVALID if (a) foreign GPU busy averages more than 2% of window wall time, measured from amdgpu DRM fdinfo engine time of every client whose executable is not a doe-work harness binary, sampled every 250 ms throughout (device gpu_busy_percent sampled every 100 ms is recorded beside it); or (b) foreign CPU time exceeds 5% of window CPU capacity (window seconds x 32 CPUs), computed as /proc/stat busy jiffies minus the harness command tree (GNU time) minus the sampler; or (c) any process fails or misses an oracle; or (d) the A/A check fails: dawn-aa/dawn warm.operation median within [0.95,1.05] with CI95 containing 1. Process snapshots at window start and end are retained as receipts.
validity.invalidWindows: An invalid window is rerun fresh under the unchanged contract; its data are retained and never used for the verdict and never reinterpreted.
